description: This source file defines the immutable class 'PolicyEntryCreated', an event class emitted after a 'PolicyEntry' is created. It includes methods for constructing instances from parameters and JSON, and for serializing the event data. It extends 'AbstractPolicyEvent' and implements 'PolicyEvent', providing metadata, resource path, and JSON serialization details.
